=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:line 315 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The probe treats only Docker exit code 125 as a daemon refusal, so the reported cgroup error may be classified as inconclusive rather than triggering the cgroupfs retry and fail-closed path.
  WHY: Sonnet says the Docker CLI maps this error to 127; Minimax and Qwen dispute that diagnosis and say daemon errors map to 125.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:lines 279-306 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The refused `docker import` path discards the daemon's stderr and logs only a generic refusal, hiding the underlying cause.
  WHY: Minimax rates this MAJOR while Sonnet and OpenAI rate it NIT; the discarded error prevents operators from distinguishing cgroup, storage, quota, or other import failures.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:lines 303-306 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The refused-import branch logs `probe_exit=import` instead of the numeric Docker import exit code required by the documented `probe_exit=<n>` contract.
  WHY: Minimax rates this MAJOR while Sonnet rates it NIT; parsers expecting an integer may fail on or miss import-refusal entries.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:line 283 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: An unrecognized `VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_CGROUP_MODE` value silently selects the systemd path.
  WHY: A typo such as `cgoupfs` does not fail or select cgroupfs and may lead to hard-to-debug container start failures.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:around line 350 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Values other than `cgroupfs` silently take the systemd-attempt branch, so unsupported configuration values are not surfaced.
  WHY: Both reviewers report that the documented values are `auto` and `cgroupfs`, but unsupported values are not warned about or logged.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:`sandbox_systemd_session` around lines 218-227 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `loginctl enable-linger` persists after provisioning or sandbox teardown without a compensating `disable-linger`.
  WHY: On self-hosted or reused runners, the sandbox user's linger and user service can remain on the host after the job.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: Values other than the documented `auto` and `cgroupfs` silently take the auto path.
